prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Redo an AshenSpire animation sprite atlas using ONLY the attached isolated Ready knight as the locked identity AND exact locked weapon model. The previous attempt failed because the axe morphed between poses. Highest priority: all poses use the EXACT SAME RIGID AXE from this reference, as though the same prop is rotated, never redesigned. One single bearded crescent blade on ONE side of the head, the same notch, same two pointed tips, same thick spine, same brass square socket/collar, same straight dark wooden haft, same butt cap. Lock blade-to-haft proportions, shaft length, blade width, and collar location across ALL cells. The AXE IS NOT A SWORD, HAMMER, DOUBLE AXE, SHORT HAND AXE, or SCYTHE. Never add a second blade. Keep weapon broadside to camera so its identical silhouette is obvious in every frame. Rigidly rotate the complete prop as a unit; do not swivel blade independently of shaft. Exactly one axe per full-body frame. Both hands grip the SAME straight haft with hand order never switching: right nearer head, left nearer butt. Same two arms anatomically connected, separated fists, fingers around shaft, no body or helmet intersections. Match this exact Reaver outfit/helmet/cape/palette/proportions and detailed painted dark fantasy style. No sword/shield. Same 3/4 screen-right facing and body scale. Generate ALL 16 cells together on a true transparent RGBA square atlas, exactly 4x4 equal cells, one figure per cell, generous transparent gutters. Entire bodies, feet and axe stay inside each cell; do not crop. Heavy two-handed diagonal cleave with torso weight transfer and deliberate recovery: Row1 READY like reference, ATK01 draw the SAME axe back low behind shoulder, ATK02 lift SAME axe behind shoulder, ATK03 overhead apex SAME axe above head. Row2 ATK04 release into downward diagonal with SAME axe high in front, ATK05 impact SAME axe extended at front waist height, ATK06 followthrough SAME axe low ahead of forward knee, ATK07 recover SAME axe toward guard. These seven frames must show incremental continuous motion of the identical weapon, not unrelated prop poses. Row3 DEFEND same axe haft across body; HURT torso recoils both hands retain same axe; CAST left hand opens in gesture while right supports same axe vertically with butt planted at boot; AGGRESSIVE two-hand forward threat. Row4 DEFENSIVE compact two-hand guard; BUFF two-hand composed rally with same axe upright, butt on ground and blade at top; PORTRAIT chest-up knight without weapon; CONVERSATION relaxed knight both hands supporting same upright axe with blade at top. Absolutely no baked glow, aura, particles, trails, fire, smoke, magical light, shadows, scenery, text, numbers, labels, grids, or watermarks. Effects excluded even from cast and buff. Output 2048x2048 if available. Weapon consistency takes precedence over decorative detail.
